def transform(g):
    g=[row[:] for row in g]
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    glines=[r for r in range(H) if len(set(g[r]))==1 and g[r][0]!=0]
    bounds=[]
    for i,g0 in enumerate(glines):
        top = glines[i-1]+1 if i>0 else 0
        bot = glines[i+1]-1 if i+1<len(glines) else H-1
        bounds.append((g0,top,bot))
    for g0,top,bot in bounds:
        for c in range(1,10):
            # shape of color c must touch the gridline
            if not any(g[r][x]==c for r in (g0-1,g0+1) if 0<=r<H for x in range(W)): continue
            ha=g0-top; hb=bot-g0
            for k in range(max(ha,hb)):

                if not (top<=ra<g0 and g0<rb<=bot): continue
                for x in range(W):
                    if g[ra][x]==c and g[rb][x]==0: g[rb][x]=c
                    elif g[rb][x]==c and g[ra][x]==0: g[ra][x]=c
